subject: MAP: evidence ownership, acceptance matrix, and DPA exceptions
messages:
From: Megan Lawson <megan.lawson@fintegral.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@fintegral.com, rajiv.patel@fintegral.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: MAP kickoff & initial evidence requests (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Connor —

Thanks for the quick sync last week. As discussed, Fintegral is preparing our procurement package and needs a short mutual action plan (MAP) that captures the security/compliance gates we require before PO and legal signoff. High-level asks from our side:

- SOC 2: scope confirmation (in-scope systems + control owner contact), most recent Type II summary report, and a list of compensating controls for any open exceptions.
- SIG/CAIQ: completed questionnaire (or a path to closure for high/critical items).
- DPA: redline and any required retention limits (we have strict EU customer data segments).
- Data retention: explicit retention windows for embeddings, logs, and backups; delete/archival procedures.

Can you produce an acceptance matrix that maps each gate to an owner, deliverable, and target date? Attaching our SOC 2 summary template for reference.

Ideal timeline from our side: MAP + acceptance criteria by 11/12, evidence intake sprint 11/15–11/26, contract signature target 12/03. If any gate needs longer (e.g., CAIQ remediation), call it out.

Appreciate it — please loop in legal and security owners.

Thanks,
Megan Lawson
Head of InfoSec, Fintegral
Megan.lawson@fintegral.com
Attachment: SOC2-Type2-2025-summary.pdf (attachment stub)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Lawson <megan.lawson@fintegral.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & initial evidence requests (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Megan —

Thanks, this is clear and reasonable. I've drafted an initial acceptance matrix below so we can iterate quickly. Owner assignments are proposals — happy to adjust.

Acceptance matrix (draft):
- SOC 2 scope confirmation: deliverable = scope doc + control owner list; owner = Mina Haddad (Security); target = 2026-11-09
- SOC 2 Type II summary + key exceptions: deliverable = PDF summary + exception log; owner = Mina Haddad; target = 2026-11-12
- SIG/CAIQ: deliverable = completed questionnaire + mitigation notes for high/critical; owner = Mina Haddad (with Fintegral follow-up); target = 2026-11-19
- DPA redline + retention windows: deliverable = redlined DPA + retention table; owner = Laura Bennett (Legal); target = 2026-11-12
- Evidence intake sprint / upload: deliverable = Drive intake folder + indexing sheet; owner = Neha Kapoor (CS/Onboarding lead); sprint = 2026-11-15 to 2026-11-26
- Final acceptance review / signoff: deliverable = acceptance checklist signed by Fintegral Sec + Redwood Legal; owner = Megan Lawson & Laura Bennett; target = 2026-11-30

If this looks okay, we'll schedule a 30-min working session to walk through the SOC 2 package and the SIG gaps on 11/09.

CC'ing Neha to coordinate the intake sprint and Laura for the DPA redline.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Megan Lawson <megan.lawson@fintegral.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & initial evidence requests (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Sounds good — I'll own the intake sprint logistics. Quick notes:

- I'll provision a shared Drive folder and an index template by 11/10. Please label evidence files with the control ID (SOC2) or CAIQ question number.
- For PO timing, procurement needs a signed DPA + acceptance checklist before issuing a PO; we'll aim for the 12/03 signature target but if DPA redline extends past 11/12 we should flag an alternate PO hold date.
- I'll schedule the intake kickoff for 11/15 and invite Fintegral's evidence reviewers (Megan / Rajiv).

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Megan Lawson <megan.lawson@fintegral.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & initial evidence requests (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Connor/Neha —

I've attached a DPA redline with two proposed exceptions we need Fintegral to consider: 1) a standard carve-out for aggregated telemetry used for model improvement (we propose a 90-day ephemeral window for training-related logs), and 2) a reciprocal security incident notification SLA of 72 hours.

Retention clarification: Redwood separates transient inference cache (24–72 hours), customer-configurable embeddings retention (default 30 days), and long-term backups (90 days unless otherwise contracted). I'll add this table to the DPA redline.

If Fintegral needs a tighter EU retention window for embeddings, note that it may require a configuration change and separate SOW for data lifecycle enforcement — that would push the timeline.

Attachment: DPA-redline-Fintegral-20261112.docx (attachment stub)

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
From: Megan Lawson <megan.lawson@fintegral.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & initial evidence requests (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Thanks for the draft map and the redline, team. A few confirmations from Fintegral: 

- The SOC 2 Type II summary you provided last year is helpful; we still need the control owner list and the exception log by 11/12 (Mina, can you upload to the intake folder?).
- DPA exceptions: Fintegral can accept the telemetry carve-out limited to aggregated, non-identifiable signals (we will accept the 90-day ephemeral window for training telemetry). The incident SLA of 72 hours is acceptable. Laura — we'll review your redline and post comments in the document.
- SIG/CAIQ: we'll run the questionnaire against our high-sensitivity checklist; if more than 3 high/critical items require remediation, we may request a targeted remediation plan (timeline to be agreed).

Next steps:
1) Mina to upload SOC2 scope + exceptions by COB 11/12.
2) Neha to share Drive intake folder and index template by 11/10 (we'll use that for the 11/15 sprint).
3) Laura and Fintegral legal to finalize DPA redlines; DocuSign route once mutual edits are resolved (Connor — we'll need the DocuSign link).
4) Working session: 11/19 10:00–10:30 AM ET to review SIG high items and acceptance criteria.

We'll align internally if the SIG run uncovers >3 high items; as noted, that will be a MAP exception item with an agreed remediation timeline.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Megan
Megan Lawson
Head of InfoSec, Fintegral
megan.lawson@fintegral.com
